newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-VALENCIA BATTLE THROUGH TO QUARTER-FINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VALENCIA BATTLE THROUGH TO QUARTER-FINALS.

text.p: Valencia, whose coach Luis Aragones quit after they beat Turkey's Besiktas 3-1 in their UEFA Cup third-round first-leg match, battled into the quarter-finals on Tuesday.
The Spanish side, with ex-Real Madrid coach Jorge Valdano now in charge, drew the second leg against Besiktas 2-2 to go through 5-3 on aggragate.
Besiktas went ahead in the 16th minute with a 30-metre deflected shot from Serdar Topraktepe filling the Turkish side with hope.
Gaping holes in their defence, however, led to an equaliser from Claudio Lopez eight minutes later.
In a scrappy game, Besiktas allowed their opponents too many chances. A clever goal from Goran Vlaovic in the 44th minute followed a basic error at the back from the Turks.
However, Besiktas were back on terms moments before halftime when Oktay Derelioglu scored from the spot.
Both teams fought each other to a standstill in the second half, but Valencia generally comfortable defending their first leg advantage.
